files.requirements.md: Invoice downloads are tenant-private. Authenticated members can download their own tenant's invoices. Invoice IDs may be guessed. Cancellation must persist status=cancelled; retry is allowed. The public handlers below are the actual exposed routes; no additional tenant middleware exists. Review only.
files.test/notes.md: Existing mocked tests assert HTTP 200 and cancelled=true. They do not simulate a failed database write or cross-tenant lookup. No executed test results are supplied.

prompt: Review these handlers and supporting files for acceptance. Inspect the actual source and requirements. Give a verdict, actionable findings with evidence and proportionate corrections. Do not edit files or run the full suite.
graderCriteria: Identifies cross-tenant invoice disclosure through the ID-only lookup, despite authentication; gives the actual reachable path and tenant-scoped correction.
Identifies that cancelled=true/200 is returned after a database write throws, violating persistent-cancellation requirements; distinguishes this from a mere logging preference.
Does not report SQL injection in the shown parameterized queries or claim the cancel query lacks a tenant predicate.
Distinguishes inadequate mocked coverage from proved runtime defects, prioritizes substantive issues and remains read-only; does not claim tests ran without evidence.
